glance.question: Is caring for creation part of gospel obedience, or a rival to the Great Commission?

positions.name: Creation Care as Christian Obligation
positions.claim: Stewarding the earth is core obedience and love of neighbor, not an optional cause.

positions.name: Gospel Priority over Environmental Activism
positions.claim: Steward wisely, but keep evangelism first and resist activism that becomes a substitute gospel.

positions.name: Gospel-Rooted Stewardship
positions.claim: Creation care belongs to gospel obedience, grounded in Christ's lordship rather than secular environmentalism.

start_here.title: 3 Foundational Truths for Creation Care
start_here.author: Andrew Spencer
start_here.why: A short biblical case, starting from Genesis 1 and Francis Schaeffer, that creation is valuable in itself and should be stewarded for God's glory.

start_here.title: What Is Biblical Stewardship?
start_here.author: R.C. Sproul
start_here.why: Sproul reads the dominion mandate as stewardship of a world that remains God's possession: productive work joined to care, protection and beautification.

start_here.title: Creation Care in an Age of Despair
start_here.author: Rinah Fiol
start_here.why: A Gen Z writer argues that a hopeful creation ethic answers both eco-anxiety and escapism.

key_number.text: 91% of evangelical Protestants say God gave humans a duty to protect and care for the Earth; 28% say the Earth is warming mostly because of human activity.
key_number.study: 2023-24 Religious Landscape Study: Religion and views on the environment
